entries.description: Elaborated stub spec: added Session Set Configuration block (requiresUAT: false, requiresE2E: false) and full step lists for Sessions 1-3.
Routed ai-assignment.md authoring via analysis call.

Routed two focused architecture sub-calls to gemini-pro (Anthropic API credits depleted): (A) D20 casing normalization decision, (B) D1/D2 DatabaseManifest shape. Deviation from spec: used gemini-pro via query() instead of opus via route() due to Anthropic API credit exhaustion.

Authored harvester-schema.v1.0.json in-conversation: applied D20 (PascalCase), D1/D2 (DatabaseManifest), D3/D4/D8/D9/D10/D13/D16 gap fixes, and added all enrichment pipeline types from sessions #14-#16 (FormComponentSpec, QueryAbstraction, EventHandlerClassification, FunctionClassification, NavigationGraph, ValidationRule, RowSourceSpec, UnresolvedItem). Note: architecture call could not route to Opus (Anthropic API credits depleted); authored in-conversation on Sonnet orchestrator using focused gemini-pro sub-calls for the two open design decisions.

Authored docs/schema/v1-adr.md: ADR documenting all v0->v1 changes, architecture decisions (D20 PascalCase, D1/D2 DatabaseManifest), gap fixes applied, new types added, deferred items, known issues (PredicateNode polymorphism), and back-compatibility plan.
dotnet build: 283 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: 1509 passed, 2 skipped (COM-gated). No regressions from schema file additions.
End-of-session verification via route(session-verification). Verifier: gpt-5-4.
Routed next-orchestrator recommendation for Session 2 via analysis.

Read Session 1 actuals from ai-assignment.md. Session 1 actuals are present. Session 3 recommendation was already routed in Session 1; will refresh Session 3 recommendation at end of session (Step 8) when actuals are complete.

Authored three example fixtures conforming to harvester-schema.v1.0.json: examples/minimal-form.json (smallest valid DatabaseManifest with one form + one table), examples/complex-form.json (full form exercising events, validation rules, row sources, subforms, parser output, FunctionClassification, EventHandlerClassification, NavigationGraph), examples/northwind-output.json (representative multi-form Northwind example with 3 forms, 1 report, 2 queries, 4 tables, relationships, navigation graph, unresolved items, diagnostics). Deviation from spec: examples are hand-crafted against the schema rather than generated by running the harvester (the CLI has no emit-manifest command; the harvester produces per-object ir/ files, not a DatabaseManifest document). This will be disclosed in the verification prompt.

Code-review of generated examples handled in-conversation per the "orchestrator model matches routing target" convention (orchestrator is Sonnet; code-review routes to Sonnet). All three examples reviewed for required field coverage against harvester-schema.v1.0.json. No missing required fields found. All enum values verified against schema. HarvestedItem oneOf discriminator (ItemKind const) pattern confirmed correct for Draft 2020-12.

Authored AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Validation/SchemaValidator.cs and SchemaValidationResult.cs. Added JsonSchema.Net 9.2.0 NuGet to AccessHarvester.Pipeline.csproj. SchemaValidator loads harvester-schema.v1.0.json at construction time, validates a JSON document string via JsonDocument.Parse + JsonSchema.Evaluate with OutputFormat.List, and collects per-keyword error messages from detail nodes. Hard-fail pattern: caller checks IsValid and throws on false. Pipeline project builds clean.

Authored tests/AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests/Validation/SchemaValidatorTests.cs. Added JsonSchema.Net 9.2.0 to Pipeline.Tests.csproj. Three tests: (a) conformant minimal DatabaseManifest passes; (b) missing SchemaType fails; (c) unknown additional field accepted (additionalProperties not forbidden at v1).

Schema-validation step for examples-vs-schema handled in-conversation (orchestrator is Sonnet; spec pins schema-validation to Sonnet — same model, handled per the "orchestrator matches routing target" convention). All required fields verified for each of the three example files against harvester-schema.v1.0.json. Enum values, oneOf discriminators (ItemKind const), and nullable patterns verified. No conformance gaps found.

dotnet build: 0 errors, 4 warnings (pre-existing). dotnet test: 1512 passed, 2 skipped (COM-gated integration tests, same count as Session 1). All 3 new SchemaValidatorTests pass: conformant document returns valid, missing required field returns invalid, unknown field accepted.
End-of-session verification via route(session-verification). Verifier: gpt-5-4.
